observations.title: Illustration cannot establish wheel condition
observations.explanation: The selected image is a stylized wheel drawing labeled “Synthetic wheel illustration,” not a vehicle photograph. White marks appear along the lower-left rim edge, but they do not establish actual damage. Tire tread, sidewall condition, and the claimed front-left wheel location cannot be assessed from this image.

recommendedAction.title: Request actual wheel and tire photographs
recommendedAction.instructions: Request clear photographs of the vehicle’s front-left wheel, including the full rim, tire sidewall, and tread, plus a wider view showing its position on the vehicle.
